payload.description: This notebook reproduces figures from an interval statistics analysis using BChron age models, focusing on median interval values. It requires pre-existing pickle files and utilizes various Python libraries to load data, sort it by latitude, and apply interval statistic techniques. The outputs include visualizations of the interval statistics using Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) plots.
